exercises.name: Slow Rib Breathing
steps: Sit tall with your hands resting on your thighs.
Breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds: belly, then ribs open without effort.
Breathe out slowly for 6 seconds. Stop if you feel any pain.

exercises.name: Gentle Chest Opener
steps: Stand with your arms by your sides and your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your palms forward and open your shoulders a little.
Breathe slowly, without pressing on your ribs or going to the point of pain.

exercises.name: Chin Tucks
steps: Sit or stand tall, eyes looking straight ahead.
Slide your chin straight back without tilting your head down.
Hold for 3 seconds while you breathe slowly, release, and repeat.

exercises.name: Side Neck Stretch
steps: Keep your shoulders relaxed and tilt one ear gently toward the shoulder.
Don't pull on your head: its own weight is enough.
Breathe slowly and switch sides halfway through.

exercises.name: Elbow Circles
steps: Place your fingertips on your shoulders, elbows at shoulder height.
Draw small, slow circles with your elbows.
Breathe out as you open and in as you close. Keep the movement smooth.

exercises.name: Wall Slides
steps: Stand with your back, head and arms against a wall, elbows bent.
Slide your arms up the wall as far as is comfortable.
Lower slowly without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Reach for the Ceiling
steps: Stand tall with your hands together above your head.
Grow gently upward without arching your back.
Breathe slowly and come back down smoothly.

exercises.name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft.
Tilt your pelvis forward and back, slowly.
Look for a long, relaxed back and breathe calmly.

exercises.name: Upper Back Opener on a Foam Roller
steps: Lie with a foam roller under your shoulder blades, knees bent, hands behind your head.
Let your upper back open gently over the roller.
Breathe slowly, never force the movement, and stay away from your lower back.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
steps: Start on hands and knees, then sit back on your heels with your arms stretched forward.
Rest your forehead on the floor and let your back relax.
Breathe into your back without pushing on your arms.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Stand with one foot in front of the other, knees soft.
Gently push your pelvis forward, keeping your back straight.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel on a mat with one knee down and the other foot in front.
Move your pelvis forward gently until you feel the front of the hip.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extension Stretch
steps: Sit on the edge of a chair with a straight back.
Straighten one leg with the toes pointing up, without locking the knee.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Belly Breathing
steps: Sit tall with one hand on your belly.
Breathe in through your nose: only the belly rises, the ribs stay soft.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth, without effort, 5 to 6 times.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
steps: Sit or stand with relaxed shoulders.
Breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 4 without tensing, breathe out for 4, pause for 4.
If you feel any discomfort in your chest, shorten the counts.

exercises.name: Shoulder Circles
steps: Let your arms hang and your shoulders relax, sitting or standing.
Roll your shoulders forward, up, back and down, slowly.
Reverse the direction halfway through, without forcing.

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrugs
steps: Let your arms hang by your sides.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears as you breathe in.
Let them drop softly as you breathe out.

exercises.name: Interlaced Overhead Stretch
steps: Stand with your fingers interlaced and your palms facing the ceiling.
Stretch your arms up, shoulders down, without arching.
Breathe slowly and release before any discomfort.

exercises.name: Triceps Stretch
steps: Put one hand behind your head, elbow pointing to the ceiling.
Hold that elbow with the other hand and pull very gently.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch arms.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
steps: Stand with your arms stretched out to the sides at shoulder height.
Draw small, slow circles, then reverse the direction.
Breathe normally and keep your shoulders low.

exercises.name: Elbows Back
steps: Stand with your hands on your lower back and elbows out to the sides.
Gently bring your elbows back, without forcing.
Breathe slowly and release before any discomfort in your chest.

exercises.name: Arm Against the Wall
steps: Stand with one forearm bent against a wall or a door frame.
Lean gently toward that arm until you feel a light stretch along the side.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch arms.

exercises.name: Gentle Doorway Chest Stretch
steps: In a doorway, rest your forearm on the frame with your elbow below your shoulder.
Step forward very slightly, chest upright, until you feel a gentle stretch.
Hold for 15 seconds without pain, switch sides.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt on the Floor
steps: Lie on your back with your feet on the floor and your heels under your knees.
Lift only your pelvis, to lengthen your lower back.
Breathe slowly and lower down one vertebra at a time.

exercises.name: Knee Across the Body, Gentle Twist
steps: Lie on your back with your right leg straight, bend the left knee and cross it toward the right.
Let the knee drop by itself: it doesn't need to touch the floor.
Breathe slowly, stay without forcing, switch sides.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Stretch
steps: Lie on your side with the bottom knee bent in front of you.
Reach the top arm over your head, without pulling hard.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds, switch sides.

exercises.name: Lower Back on a Foam Roller
steps: Sit with a foam roller under your lower back, arms crossed in front of you.
Roll very gently, with the weight on the lower back (never on the ribs).
Stop at the first sign of pain.

exercises.name: Quad Stretch Against the Wall
steps: Kneel facing away from a wall, with the back foot resting against it.
Place your pelvis above the back knee, chest upright.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg bent at 90 degrees in front and the other out to the side.
Keep your chest tall and both buttocks on the floor.
Switch the knees to the other side, slowly.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
steps: Stand holding on to something solid.
Lift one foot and draw a big circle with your big toe.
Reverse the direction, then switch feet.

exercises.name: Knee Circles
steps: Stand with your feet together and your hands on your knees.
Make small, slow circles with your knees.
Breathe normally and change direction halfway through.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch in a Short Lunge
steps: Stand with one foot a little in front of the other, back heel on the floor.
Bend both knees without lifting the back heel.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
steps: Sit with one leg straight and the other foot against your inner thigh.
Lean forward from the hips with a long back until you feel a light stretch.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Circles
steps: Stand on one leg with one hand on a support.
Lift the other knee to 90 degrees and open the hip in a big circle.
Stay slow and smooth, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
steps: Sit or stand with your arms in front of you and your wrists loose.
Draw small circles with your wrists.
Reverse the direction halfway through.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch with a Band
steps: Lie on your back with one leg up and a band under the ball of the foot.
Pull gently on the band, with the knee almost straight.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Glute and Outer Thigh Stretch with a Band
steps: Lie on your back with a band around one foot and the leg straight.
Bring the leg toward the opposite side without lifting your shoulders.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Seated Leg and Calf Stretch with a Band
steps: Sit with your legs straight and a band around one foot.
Lean forward a little and pull the band to bring your toes toward you.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Standing Leg and Calf Stretch with a Band
steps: Stand with one foot forward with a band around it and the leg almost straight.
Lean forward slightly with your toes up, pulling on the band.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hamstring Stretch
steps: Lie on your back, hips and knees bent at 90 degrees, calves resting on a chair or the wall.
Slowly straighten one leg toward the ceiling, only as far as feels comfortable.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Inner Thigh Foam Roll
steps: Lie face down, one leg bent out to the side with the inner thigh on a foam roller.
Roll slowly along the inner thigh, staying away from the knee and the groin.
Pause on tender spots while you breathe, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Kneeling Groin Stretch
steps: On hands and knees, slide one leg out to the side with the foot flat.
Sit your hips back slowly until you feel a mild stretch on the inner thigh.
Breathe for 15 seconds, come back gently, switch sides.

exercises.name: All Fours Quad Stretch
steps: On hands and knees, bring one heel toward your buttock and hold the foot with the same-side hand.
Keep the hips level and the back long.
Hold for 15 seconds without pulling hard, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Figure-Four Hip Stretch
steps: Sit tall on a chair, rest one ankle on the opposite knee.
Lean forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the outer hip.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathing slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch, Forearms on the Wall
steps: Stand facing a wall, forearms on it, one foot back with the heel down.
Bend the front knee and lean in gently until the back calf stretches.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch, Hands on the Wall
steps: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands on it, one foot back with the heel down.
Keep the back leg straight and press the heel into the floor.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Calf Foam Roll
steps: Sit with a foam roller under your calves, hands behind you.
Lift the hips and roll slowly from the ankle to just below the knee.
Slow down on tender spots and breathe, then switch to one leg at a time if you like.

exercises.name: Cat Stretch
steps: On hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Breathe out and round your back toward the ceiling, chin toward the chest.
Breathe in and come back to a flat back. Repeat slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Lower Back Stretch
steps: Sit on a chair with your feet flat, knees apart.
Let your head and chest fold forward between your knees, arms hanging.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds, then roll back up one vertebra at a time.

exercises.name: Chest Opener on a Gym Ball
steps: Sit on a gym ball, then walk your feet forward and lie back until the ball supports your upper back.
Let your arms open out to the sides, palms up.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds and sit up gently.

exercises.name: Chin to Chest Stretch
steps: Sit or stand tall, shoulders relaxed.
Lower your chin slowly toward your chest until you feel the back of the neck lengthen.
Breathe for 15 seconds, then lift your head back up slowly.

exercises.name: Lying Spinal Twist
steps: Lie on your back, arms out to the sides, one knee bent with the foot on the floor.
Let the opposite knee fall across your body while the shoulders stay on the floor.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Dynamic Back Stretch
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging loosely.
Swing the arms gently across the chest and back out again, turning the upper body a little.
Keep the movement small and smooth, and breathe normally.

exercises.name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
steps: Stand tall with your arms stretched forward at shoulder height.
Open your arms out to the sides and back, as far as is comfortable, then bring them forward again.
Move slowly with the breath: in as you open, out as you close.

exercises.name: Seated Butterfly Stretch
steps: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out to the sides.
Hold your feet and lengthen your back, leaning forward only a little.
Breathe for 15 seconds without pressing on the knees.

exercises.name: Hamstring Foam Roll
steps: Sit with a foam roller under your thighs, hands on the floor behind you.
Lift the hips and roll slowly from the sit bones to just above the knees.
Slow down on tender spots and breathe.

exercises.name: Hug a Gym Ball
steps: Kneel in front of a gym ball and rest your chest and arms on it.
Let your arms wrap around the ball and your back round and relax.
Breathe slowly for 20 seconds, sinking a little more with each breath out.

exercises.name: Hug Knees to Chest
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Bring both knees toward your chest and hold them with your hands.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds, then release gently.

exercises.name: Outer Thigh Foam Roll
steps: Lie on one side with a foam roller under the outer thigh, forearm on the floor, other foot in front for balance.
Roll slowly between the hip and just above the knee.
Slow down on tender spots, breathe, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Kneeling Forearm Stretch
steps: Kneel on all fours with your palms on the floor, fingers pointing toward your knees.
Sit back slowly until you feel a mild stretch along the forearms.
Hold for 15 seconds and ease off at the first sign of discomfort.

exercises.name: Side Back Foam Roll
steps: Lie on one side with a foam roller under the armpit area, the lower arm stretched out in front.
Roll slowly a few centimetres up and down along the side of your back.
Breathe slowly, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Leg-Up Hamstring Stretch
steps: Lie on your back and lift one leg, holding behind the thigh or calf with both hands.
Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor and the knee soft.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathing slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Looking at the Ceiling
steps: Stand tall with your hands resting on your lower back.
Lift your chin and look up slowly, as far as feels comfortable.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower your gaze back to the front.

exercises.name: Middle Back Stretch
steps: Sit or stand and clasp your hands in front of you at chest height.
Round the upper back and push the hands away until you feel the area between the shoulder blades.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds, then release.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
steps: Lie on one side with the bottom knee bent for balance.
Bend the top knee and hold that ankle, bringing the heel toward your buttock.
Keep the knees close, hold for 15 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: One Knee to Chest
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight, or one knee bent for comfort.
Hug one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathing slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Glute Foam Roll
steps: Sit on a foam roller with one ankle resting on the opposite knee, hands behind you.
Lean slightly toward the side of the crossed leg and roll slowly over the buttock.
Slow down on tender spots and breathe, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Gym Ball Forward Fold
steps: Kneel behind a gym ball and rest your forearms on it.
Roll the ball forward a little while you sink your chest toward the floor.
Breathe for 15 seconds and roll back slowly.

exercises.name: Thigh Foam Roll
steps: Lie face down with a foam roller under your thighs, on your forearms.
Roll slowly from the hip to just above the knee.
Slow down on tender spots and breathe.

exercises.name: Upper Back Foam Roll
steps: Lie on your back with a foam roller under your shoulder blades, knees bent, arms crossed over your chest.
Lift the hips slightly and roll a few centimetres up and down.
Stay on the upper back, away from the neck and the lower back, and breathe.

exercises.name: Runner's Lunge
steps: Step one foot forward into a lunge, hands on the front thigh or a chair.
Keep the back leg straight and press the back heel toward the floor.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Stretch
steps: Sit on the floor or a chair with one leg stretched out in front.
Pull your toes toward you, keeping the knee soft.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathing slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Stretch
steps: Sit tall on a chair and interlace your fingers.
Turn your palms to the ceiling and reach up, shoulders down.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds and release.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
steps: Bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Hold it just above the elbow with the other hand and pull gently toward you.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathing, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Inner Thigh Stretch
steps: Lie on your side with the top leg bent and its knee resting on a cushion or the floor in front of you.
Stretch the bottom leg out and let it relax.
Breathe for 15 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Side Wrist Pull
steps: Stand tall and clasp one wrist with the other hand in front of you.
Gently pull that wrist across and down to the side, lengthening the arm and the side of the neck.
Hold for 15 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Seated Spinal Twist
steps: Sit tall on a chair, feet flat, and hold the back of the seat or the backrest.
Turn your chest slowly to one side, keeping both hips on the chair.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathing slowly, then turn to the other side.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Stretch
steps: Stand facing a wall, one foot back with the heel on the floor and the leg straight.
Lean forward until you feel the back calf stretch.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Standing Side Bend
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and one arm reaching overhead.
Lean slowly to the opposite side, lengthening the whole side of the body.
Hold for 15 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Standing Forward Fold
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Fold forward from the hips and let your arms hang toward the floor.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds, then roll back up slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Straddle Stretch
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs open in a comfortable V.
Walk your hands forward with a long back, only as far as feels easy.
Breathe for 15 seconds and come back up slowly.

exercises.name: Gym Ball Torso Rotation
steps: Lie with your upper back on a gym ball, feet wide, arms stretched up.
Rotate slowly to one side, keeping the hips still.
Return to the centre and rotate to the other side, breathing slowly.

exercises.name: Triceps Side Stretch
steps: Raise one arm and bend the elbow, hand behind your head.
Lean gently to the opposite side, letting the elbow point up.
Hold for 15 seconds, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Upper Back Stretch
steps: Hold your hands together in front of you and round your upper back.
Let your head drop forward and reach your hands away from you.
Breathe into the upper back for 15 seconds, then release.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
steps: Step into a long lunge and place both hands on the floor inside the front foot.
Rotate your chest toward the front knee and reach that arm to the ceiling.
Breathe for a few seconds, return slowly, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
steps: Hold a light resistance band in front of you at chest height, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by squeezing your shoulder blades together, arms staying straight.
Return slowly and repeat with the breath, keeping the shoulders down.

exercises.name: Shoulder External Rotation with Band
steps: Hold a light band with both hands, elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your side.
Turn the forearm outward slowly, keeping the elbow in place.
Return slowly. Do the repetitions with one arm, then the other.

exercises.name: Shoulder Internal Rotation with Band
steps: Hold a light band with the elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your side.
Turn the forearm inward across your belly slowly, keeping the elbow in place.
Return slowly. Do the repetitions with one arm, then the other.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pirate Ship
steps: Stand tall holding a light kettlebell by the handle with both hands.
Draw a slow, wide arc with it in front of you, from one side to the other, over your head.
Keep the movement smooth and stay within a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Gym Ball Hip Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on a gym ball and your knees bent.
Lift your hips slowly until your body forms a line from shoulders to knees.
Hold for a breath and lower with control.
